# Public catalogue {#sec-exhibition-catalogue}

This part of the book presents the exhibition itself: where and when it was shown, the artist, the catalogue that accompanied it, and the works, with a mark for each work that was on view.

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "src"))

import zipfile
import pandas as pd
from baldessari import cps, wikidata, table

WIKIDATA = "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/"


def day(value) -> str:
    ts = pd.to_datetime(str(value)[:10])
    return f"{ts.day} {ts:%B %Y}"


def venue_name(host: str) -> str:
    return host.split(",")[0].split()[-1]


exh = cps.exhibitions().sort_values("start").reset_index(drop=True)
cat = cps.catalogues().iloc[0]
on_view = cps.exhibited_works()
works = cps.artworks()
profile = wikidata.artist_profile()
```

## Exhibition

```{python}
#| label: exhibition-info
#| output: asis
title = exh["label"].iloc[0]
print(f"*{title}*\n")

rows = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Venue": exh["host"],
        "Dates": [f"{day(s)} – {day(e)}" for s, e in zip(exh["start"], exh["end"])],
        "Works on view": exh["works"],
        "Wikidata": [
            f"[View on Wikidata]({WIKIDATA}{q})" if isinstance(q, str) and q else "Not yet on Wikidata"
            for q in exh["wikidata"]
        ],
    }
)
print(table(rows).data)

linked = exh[exh["wikidata"].notna() & (exh["wikidata"] != "")]
if len(linked):
    items = "\n".join(
        f"- [{h}]({WIKIDATA}{q})" for h, q in zip(linked["host"], linked["wikidata"])
    )
    print(
        '\n::: {.callout-tip title="Find the exhibition on Wikidata"}\n'
        "The exhibition is also described in Wikidata, the free knowledge base. "
        "Follow the link to see its open, reusable record:\n\n"
        f"{items}\n:::\n"
    )
```

## Artist

```{python}
#| label: artist-info
#| output: asis
def values(pid: str) -> list[str]:
    return profile.loc[profile["pid"] == pid, "valueLabel"].tolist()


def first(pid: str) -> str:
    v = values(pid)
    return v[0] if v else ""


born = ", ".join(x for x in (day(first("P569")) if first("P569") else "", first("P19")) if x)
died = ", ".join(x for x in (day(first("P570")) if first("P570") else "", first("P20")) if x)
occupations = ", ".join(values("P106"))
education = "; ".join(values("P69"))
awards = "; ".join(values("P166"))

lines = [
    f"**John Baldessari**  ([Wikidata]({WIKIDATA}{wikidata.BALDESSARI}))\n",
    f"- **Born:** {born}",
    f"- **Died:** {died}",
    f"- **Nationality:** {first('P27')}",
    f"- **Works as:** {occupations}",
    f"- **Studied at:** {education}",
    f"- **Awards:** {awards}",
]
print("\n".join(line for line in lines if not line.endswith(":** ")))
```

## Book catalogue

```{python}
#| label: catalogue-info
#| output: asis
fields = [
    ("Title", cat["title"]),
    ("Subtitle", cat.get("subtitle")),
    ("Authors", cat.get("authors")),
    ("Publisher", cat.get("publisher")),
    ("Year", str(cat.get("published") or "")[:4]),
    ("ISBN", cat.get("isbn")),
]
print("\n".join(f"- **{k}:** {v}" for k, v in fields if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip()))
```

## Artworks

```{python}
#| label: artwork-list
#| output: asis
short = dict(zip(exh["qid"], exh["host"].map(venue_name)))
on_view = on_view.assign(
    exhibition_qid=on_view["exhibition"].str.rsplit("/", n=1).str[-1]
)
venues = (
    on_view.groupby("qid")["exhibition_qid"]
    .agg(lambda s: [short[q] for q in exh["qid"] if q in set(s)])
    .to_dict()
)


def exhibited(qid: str) -> str:
    seen = venues.get(qid, [])
    if not seen:
        return "–"
    if len(seen) == len(exh):
        return "✓ Both venues" if len(seen) == 2 else "✓ All venues"
    return "✓ " + ", ".join(seen)


def num(v) -> str:
    return "" if pd.isna(v) else f"{v:g}"


def size(row) -> str:
    parts = [num(row["height"]), num(row["width"]), num(row["depth"])]
    return " × ".join(p for p in parts if p)


def medium(row) -> str:
    stated = row["materialsStated"]
    if isinstance(stated, str) and stated.strip():
        return stated
    return row["materials"] or ""


works = works.assign(_year=works["year"].astype("Int64")).sort_values(
    ["_year", "label"], na_position="last"
)
listing = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Title": works["label"],
        "Year": works["_year"].astype("string").fillna(""),
        "Medium": works.apply(medium, axis=1),
        "Size (cm)": works.apply(size, axis=1),
        "Exhibited": works["qid"].map(exhibited),
    }
)
n_works = len(listing)
n_shown = int((listing["Exhibited"] != "–").sum())
print(
    f"The catalogue documents **{n_works} works**. "
    f"**{n_shown}** of them were on view in the exhibition (marked ✓); "
    f"the other {n_works - n_shown} are reproduced in the catalogue only.\n"
)
print('::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}\n*Click a column heading to sort the table.*\n:::\n')
print("::: {.sortable-table}\n" + table(listing).data + "\n:::")
```

```{=html}
<style>
  .sortable-table th { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; white-space: nowrap; }
  .sortable-table th::after { content: " \2195"; opacity: .35; }
  .sortable-table th[aria-sort="ascending"]::after { content: " \25B2"; opacity: 1; }
  .sortable-table th[aria-sort="descending"]::after { content: " \25BC"; opacity: 1; }
</style>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".sortable-table table").forEach(function (table) {
    var body = table.tBodies[0];
    var heads = table.querySelectorAll("thead th");
    heads.forEach(function (th, col) {
      th.tabIndex = 0;
      var sort = function () {
        var dir = th.getAttribute("aria-sort") === "ascending" ? "descending" : "ascending";
        heads.forEach(function (h) { h.removeAttribute("aria-sort"); });
        th.setAttribute("aria-sort", dir);
        var sign = dir === "ascending" ? 1 : -1;
        var value = function (row) {
          var t = row.cells[col].textContent.trim();
          return t === "\u2013" ? "" : t;
        };
        Array.from(body.rows).sort(function (a, b) {
          var x = value(a), y = value(b);
          if (x === "" && y === "") return 0;
          if (x === "") return 1;
          if (y === "") return -1;
          return sign * x.localeCompare(y, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
        }).forEach(function (row) { body.appendChild(row); });
      };
      th.addEventListener("click", sort);
      th.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); sort(); }
      });
    });
  });
});
</script>
```

## Download the exhibition data

```{python}
#| label: download-data
out = Path("downloads")
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
archive = out / "baldessari-exhibition-data.zip"

exhibitions_csv = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Exhibition": exh["label"],
        "Venue": exh["host"],
        "Start": exh["start"].str[:10],
        "End": exh["end"].str[:10],
        "Works on view": exh["works"],
        "Wikidata": [f"{WIKIDATA}{q}" if isinstance(q, str) and q else "" for q in exh["wikidata"]],
    }
)
catalogue_csv = cat.drop(labels=["qid", "dnbId", "url"], errors="ignore").to_frame().T
artworks_csv = listing.assign(
    **{"Artist": works["creator"].values, "Exhibited at": works["qid"].map(lambda q: "; ".join(venues.get(q, []))).values}
)

with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name, df in {
        "exhibitions.csv": exhibitions_csv,
        "catalogue.csv": catalogue_csv,
        "artworks.csv": artworks_csv,
    }.items():
        z.writestr(name, df.to_csv(index=False))
```

All the data shown on this page (exhibitions, catalogue and artworks) is available as a single download:

**[Download the exhibition data (ZIP of CSV files)](downloads/baldessari-exhibition-data.zip)**

The files open in Excel, Numbers or any spreadsheet. For the complete linked data behind the whole book, see [Data Downloads](book-as-data.qmd).
